verses.en: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.pt: Não repreendas ao idoso asperamente, mas exorta-o como a um pai; aos jovens, como a irmãos;
verses.en_web: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
verses.en_bbe: Do not say sharp words to one who has authority in the church, but let your talk be as to a father, and to the younger men as to brothers:

verses.en: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.pt: às idosas, como a mães; e às moças, como a irmãs, em toda pureza.
verses.en_web: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
verses.en_bbe: To the older women as to mothers, to the younger as to sisters, with a clean heart.

verses.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.pt: Honra as viúvas que são verdadeiramente viúvas.
verses.en_web: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to widows who are truly widows.

verses.en: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.pt: Mas, se alguma viúva tiver filhos ou netos, aprendam primeiro a exercer piedade com a sua própria família, e a recompensar os seus pais; porque isso é bom e agradável diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
verses.en_bbe: But if any widow has children or children's children, let these see that it is right to take care of their family and their fathers and mothers: for this is pleasing in the eyes of God.

verses.en: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.pt: A que é verdadeiramente viúva e desamparada espera em Deus, e persevera noite e dia em rogos e orações.
verses.en_web: Now she who is a widow indeed, and desolate, has her hope set on God, and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
verses.en_bbe: Now she who is truly a widow and without family puts her hope in God, giving herself to prayer day and night.

verses.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.pt: Mas a que se entrega aos prazeres, enquanto vive, está morta.
verses.en_web: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
verses.en_bbe: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she is living.

verses.en: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.pt: Manda, pois, essas coisas, para que sejam irrepreensíveis.
verses.en_web: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to this effect, so that no evil may be said of anyone.

verses.en: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.pt: Porém, se alguém não cuida dos seus, e principalmente dos de sua própria família, negou a fé, e é pior que um incrédulo.
verses.en_web: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone has no care for his family and those in his house, he is false to the faith, and is worse than one who has no faith.

verses.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.pt: A viúva, para ser registrada, não deve ter menos de sessenta anos, e haver sido mulher de um marido.
verses.en_web: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.en_bbe: Let no woman be numbered among the widows who is under sixty years old, and only if she has been the wife of one man,

verses.en: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.pt: Ela deve ter testemunho de boas obras: se criou filhos, se foi hospitaleira, se lavou os pés dos santos, se socorreu os aflitos, se seguiu toda boa obra.
verses.en_web: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
verses.en_bbe: And if witness is given of her good works; if she has had the care of children, if she has been kind to travellers, washing the feet of the saints, helping those who are in trouble, giving herself to good works.

verses.en: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.pt: Mas não admitas as viúvas jovens; porque, quando têm desejos sensuais contra Cristo, querem se casar;
verses.en_web: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;
verses.en_bbe: But to the younger widows say No: for when their love is turned away from Christ, they have a desire to be married;

verses.en: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.pt: e têm condenação, por haverem anulado a primeira fé.
verses.en_web: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
verses.en_bbe: And they are judged because they have been false to their first faith;

verses.en: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.pt: E, além disso, também aprendem a andar ociosas de casa em casa; e não somente ociosas, mas também fofoqueiras e curiosas, falando o que não se deve.
verses.en_web: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
verses.en_bbe: And they get into the way of doing no work, going about from house to house; and not only doing no work, but talking foolishly, being over-interested in the business of others, saying things which they have no right to say.

verses.en: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.pt: Por isso, quero que as mais jovens se casem, gerem filhos, administrem a casa, e não deem nenhuma oportunidade ao adversário de maldizer.
verses.en_web: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
verses.en_bbe: So it is my desire that the younger widows may be married and have children, controlling their families, and giving the Evil One no chance to say anything against them,

verses.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.pt: Pois algumas já se desviaram e seguiram Satanás.
verses.en_web: For already some have turned away after Satan.
verses.en_bbe: For even now some are turned away to Satan.

verses.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.pt: Se algum crente ou alguma crente tem viúvas, que as ajude, e não sobrecarregue a igreja, para que ela possa ajudar as que são de verdade viúvas.
verses.en_web: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened; that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
verses.en_bbe: If any woman of the faith has relations who are widows, let her give them help, so that the care of them does not come on the church, and so it may give help to those who are truly widowed.

verses.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.pt: Os presbíteros ou: anciãos que lideram bem sejam estimados como dignos de honra dobrada, principalmente os que trabalham na palavra e na doutrina.
verses.en_web: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
verses.en_bbe: Let rulers whose rule is good be honoured twice over, specially those whose work is preaching and teaching.

verses.en: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.pt: Pois a Escritura diz: “Ao boi que debulha não atarás a boca”; Deuteronômio 25:4 e: “o trabalhador é digno do seu salário”. Lucas 10:7; Levítico 19:13
verses.en_web: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Writings say, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. And, The worker has a right to his reward.

verses.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.pt: Não aceites acusação contra um presbítero, a não ser com duas ou três testemunhas.
verses.en_web: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take as true any statement made against one in authority, but only if two or three give witness to it.

verses.en: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.pt: Aos que pecarem, repreende-os na presença de todos, para que os outros também tenham temor.
verses.en_web: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
verses.en_bbe: Say sharp words to sinners when all are present, so that the rest may be in fear.

verses.en: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.pt: Ordeno-te, diante de Deus, do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e dos anjos escolhidos, que guardes essas coisas sem preconceitos, fazendo nada por favoritismo.
verses.en_web: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.en_bbe: I give you orders before God and Christ Jesus and the angels of God's selection, to keep these orders without giving thought to one side more than another.

verses.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.pt: A ninguém imponhas as mãos apressadamente, nem participes dos pecados alheios; conserva-te puro.
verses.en_web: Lay hands hastily on no one, neither be a participant in other men’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put hands on any man without thought, and have no part in other men's sins: keep yourself clean.

verses.en: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.pt: Não bebas mais somente água, mas usa também de um pouco de vinho, por causa do teu estômago, e das tuas frequentes enfermidades.
verses.en_web: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take only water as your drink, but take a little wine for the good of your stomach, and because you are frequently ill.

verses.en: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.pt: Os pecados de algumas pessoas são evidentes antes mesmo do juízo, mas os de algumas são manifestos depois.
verses.en_web: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
verses.en_bbe: The sins of some men are clearly seen, going before them to be judged; but with others, their sins go after them.

verses.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente, também, as boas obras são evidentes; e as que não são assim não se podem esconder.
verses.en_web: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, there are good works which are clearly seen; and those which are not so, may not be kept secret.
